author: IGN
description:
You can unlock Paul Walker's iconic green Mitsubishi Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious in GTA 6! This awesome Easter egg lets you steal Brian O'Conner's legendary 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse and keep it as a permanent vehicle for Jason and Lucia. Here's exactly where to find it, how to steal it, and how to register it as your own.

In this Grand Theft Auto 6 guide, we'll show you where to find the hidden Eclipse inside a garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, how to disable the security alarm, and how to use a Slim Jim to steal the car without attracting unwanted attention. We'll also explain how to register the vehicle with Moses, how much it costs, and whether its speed, acceleration, and handling make it worth picking up early in the game.

For more GTA 6 secrets, Easter eggs, vehicle locations, and walkthroughs, check out IGN's Grand Theft Auto 6 strategy guide! https://www.ign.com/wikis/gta-6

#IGN #gaming  #GTA6
title: GTA 6: How to Get Paul Walker's Eclipse (The Fast and the Furious)

author: IGN
description:
Regrets, I’ve had a few. But none in my over 100 hours with GTA 6 are quite like this.

It all began on a quiet afternoon in Vice City. It was a perfect day as the sun hung high in the sky, casting long shadows across the beach as vacation-goers and locals alike enjoyed the weather. An even darker, more sinister shadow would soon be cast over the city, though. A slice of paradise soon to be tarnished by the actions of one curious deviant: Me.
I visited the zoo in GTA 6 to commit the worst crime imaginable, and now I feel terrible. 

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: This Is the One Thing I’ll Never Do Again in GTA 6
